tasks.name: Phase 1: Foundation Infrastructure Setup
tasks.description: Set up Node.js + TypeScript backend with Express.js, Lit + TypeScript frontend with Vite, and shared interfaces
tasks.testing_strategy: Project setup validation with successful builds and basic smoke tests
tasks.notes: Foundation for entire web application - must be solid

tasks.name: Backend Express TypeScript Setup
tasks.description: Configure Express.js with TypeScript, security middleware, CORS, and basic error handling
tasks.testing_strategy: Jest + Supertest for API endpoint testing with TypeScript support
tasks.notes: Include Helmet security, CORS configuration, and compression middleware

tasks.name: Frontend Lit Web Components Setup
tasks.description: Set up Lit + TypeScript frontend with Vite build system and component architecture
tasks.testing_strategy: Vitest with browser mode for Lit component testing, avoiding JSDOM limitations
tasks.notes: Focus on reusable Web Components with reactive properties and lifecycle management

tasks.name: Shared TypeScript Interface Layer
tasks.description: Create shared TypeScript interfaces and schemas compatible with existing JSONL format
tasks.testing_strategy: Type compatibility tests ensuring backward compatibility with Python models
tasks.notes: Must maintain full compatibility with existing JSONL format and Python claude-code-log

tasks.name: WebSocket Server Implementation
tasks.description: Implement WebSocket server for real-time communication between frontend and backend
tasks.testing_strategy: WebSocket integration tests with mock clients and connection management validation
tasks.notes: Foundation for real-time session updates and live synchronization

tasks.name: Phase 1: Data Integration and Processing
tasks.description: Implement TypeScript JSONL parsing, API endpoints, caching, and file system monitoring
tasks.testing_strategy: Comprehensive parser tests with edge cases and performance benchmarks
tasks.notes: Critical for data accuracy and application performance

tasks.name: JSONL Parser TypeScript Implementation
tasks.description: Convert Python JSONL parsing logic to TypeScript with identical data model output
tasks.testing_strategy: Parser tests with representative JSONL files ensuring identical output to Python version
tasks.notes: Must handle large files efficiently and maintain exact compatibility with Python parser

tasks.name: Session Data API Endpoints
tasks.description: Create RESTful API endpoints for retrieving session data, projects, and metadata
tasks.testing_strategy: API integration tests with Supertest covering all endpoints and error conditions
tasks.notes: Include pagination, filtering, and search capabilities

tasks.name: Cache System and Performance Optimization
tasks.description: Implement intelligent caching for session data with invalidation and performance optimization
tasks.testing_strategy: Cache performance tests and invalidation logic validation
tasks.notes: Critical for handling large session datasets efficiently

tasks.name: File System Monitoring Integration
tasks.description: Add real-time file system monitoring with Node.js fs.watch for live session updates
tasks.testing_strategy: File monitoring integration tests with mock file system changes
tasks.notes: Enable automatic detection of new Claude Code sessions

tasks.name: Phase 1: Core Visualization Components
tasks.description: Build Lit Web Components for session visualization, timeline, filtering, and responsive layout
tasks.testing_strategy: Vitest browser mode for component testing with real DOM interactions
tasks.notes: Must inherit visual styling from original Python version for consistency

tasks.name: Session Detail and Message Rendering Components
tasks.description: Implement Lit Web Components for rich session detail views with syntax highlighting and collapsible content
tasks.testing_strategy: Component tests focusing on rendering accuracy and user interaction
tasks.notes: Include syntax highlighting, copy functionality, and legacy style inheritance

tasks.name: Interactive Timeline Component
tasks.description: Create zoomable, filterable timeline component with real-time updates via WebSocket
tasks.testing_strategy: Timeline interaction tests with WebSocket message simulation
tasks.notes: Support chronological visualization with smooth scrolling and zoom controls

tasks.name: Filtering and Search Components
tasks.description: Build filtering and search functionality with reactive properties and saved presets
tasks.testing_strategy: Filter and search functionality tests with various query types
tasks.notes: Include full-text search, message type filtering, and date range selection

tasks.name: Responsive Layout System
tasks.description: Implement responsive layout system using Lit's template system with mobile and desktop optimizations
tasks.testing_strategy: Responsive design tests across different viewport sizes
tasks.notes: Ensure optimal experience on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices

tasks.name: Phase 2: Session Continuation Integration
tasks.description: Enable session continuation and Claude Code CLI integration with child process management
tasks.testing_strategy: Integration tests with mock Claude Code CLI processes
tasks.notes: Core feature enabling seamless session continuation from web interface

tasks.name: Claude Code CLI Process Management
tasks.description: Implement Node.js child process management for Claude Code CLI integration with proper error handling
tasks.testing_strategy: Process management tests with mock CLI interactions and error scenarios
tasks.notes: Handle process lifecycle, stdout/stderr capture, and graceful termination

tasks.name: Session Context Preparation and Transfer
tasks.description: Create mechanisms for preparing and transferring session context to Claude Code CLI
tasks.testing_strategy: Context transfer tests ensuring proper session state reconstruction
tasks.notes: Ensure seamless continuation with full conversation context

tasks.name: Session Branching and New Session Creation
tasks.description: Build functionality for creating new sessions that branch from specific historical points
tasks.testing_strategy: Branching functionality tests with various session states
tasks.notes: Allow users to explore alternative conversation paths from any point

tasks.name: Real-time Session Status Updates
tasks.description: Implement WebSocket-driven live updates for session status and progress during continuation
tasks.testing_strategy: WebSocket integration tests for real-time status updates
tasks.notes: Provide live feedback during session continuation and CLI interactions

tasks.name: Phase 2: Enhanced Features and Capabilities
tasks.description: Add advanced features including export capabilities, user preferences, analytics, and offline support
tasks.testing_strategy: Feature-specific tests for export, preferences, and offline functionality
tasks.notes: Polish features that enhance user experience and productivity

tasks.name: Export and Sharing Capabilities
tasks.description: Add server-side processing for exporting sessions and selected messages in various formats
tasks.testing_strategy: Export functionality tests with different formats and large datasets
tasks.notes: Support multiple formats: HTML, Markdown, JSON, and PDF

tasks.name: User Preferences and Customization
tasks.description: Implement persistent user preferences including themes, layouts, and saved filter presets
tasks.testing_strategy: Preferences persistence tests across browser sessions
tasks.notes: Enable personalization while maintaining consistent core experience

tasks.name: Advanced Analytics and Token Usage Views
tasks.description: Create analytics views with real-time updates showing token consumption patterns and usage insights
tasks.testing_strategy: Analytics calculation tests and visualization rendering validation
tasks.notes: Provide insights into Claude Code usage patterns and optimization opportunities

tasks.name: Offline Support and Service Worker
tasks.description: Add service worker for offline viewing of cached sessions and performance optimizations
tasks.testing_strategy: Offline functionality tests with network simulation
tasks.notes: Enable continued productivity even without network connectivity

tasks.name: Phase 2: Testing, Polish and Production Ready
tasks.description: Comprehensive testing, performance optimization, accessibility, and production deployment preparation
tasks.testing_strategy: Full test suite with unit, integration, and e2e tests following testing diamond strategy
tasks.notes: Ensure production readiness with comprehensive testing and optimization

tasks.name: Comprehensive Backend Testing Suite
tasks.description: Implement complete Jest + Supertest testing for TypeScript backend with coverage requirements
tasks.testing_strategy: Testing diamond strategy with focus on component tests, minimal e2e tests
tasks.notes: Achieve >90% test coverage with focus on critical business logic

tasks.name: Frontend Component Testing with Vitest Browser Mode
tasks.description: Complete Lit component testing using Vitest browser mode avoiding JSDOM limitations
tasks.testing_strategy: Real browser testing for Lit components with user interaction simulation
tasks.notes: Focus on component behavior in actual browser environments

tasks.name: Performance Optimization and Accessibility
tasks.description: Implement performance optimizations, accessibility improvements, and WCAG 2.1 AA compliance
tasks.testing_strategy: Accessibility testing with automated tools and manual validation
tasks.notes: Ensure inclusive design with proper ARIA labels and keyboard navigation

tasks.name: Documentation and User Onboarding
tasks.description: Create comprehensive documentation, user guides, and onboarding experience
tasks.testing_strategy: Documentation accuracy validation and onboarding flow testing
tasks.notes: Enable smooth user adoption with clear guidance and examples
